import time

#load application

print("Scanning finished")

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all variables
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm area
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.1  # 0.1 seconds per line
scan.Lines = 32  # 32 lines per frame

# Set Z controller PID parameters
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

# Set file name prefix for scan 1
file_name = "scan_1_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

print("Starting Scan 1...")
print(f"Scan parameters: Width={scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm, Height={scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm")
print(f"Lines={scan.Lines}, Time per line={scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"PID: P={zcontrol.PGain}, I={zcontrol.IGain}, D={zcontrol.DGain}")

# Start first scan
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(1)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scan 1 finished")

del spm
